# Launchset

> Launchset is a digital design and automation studio creating distinctive websites, practical internal tools and useful automations that save time and create measurable value.

Canonical website: https://launchset.dev

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://launchset.dev/): Studio overview, selected work, services, process and contact details.
- [Our work](https://launchset.dev/work): Website projects, internal tools, automations and measurement work.
- [Founder](https://launchset.dev/founder): John Helyar's background and the problem-solving perspective behind Launchset.
- [Caple Scrape Review architecture](https://launchset.dev/work/tools/caple-scrape-review): A staged supplier-data review and catalogue pipeline.
- [Lead Audit Review architecture](https://launchset.dev/work/tools/lead-audit-review): A research, evidence, scoring and human-review system for business opportunities.

## Services

- Web design and development
- Booking and e-commerce journeys
- Business process automation
- Internal review tools and data pipelines
- Analytics access and practical measurement

## Crawl guidance

Public pages may be indexed and referenced with attribution to Launchset and a link to the canonical page. Portfolio descriptions should be treated as summaries of the work shown, not guarantees of identical results for other projects.
